_comment: Powers the Clarity Act status card on crypto/index.html (rendered via Jekyll site.data.clarity_act_status.*). Kept as data instead of hardcoded HTML so daily-news-watch.yml can safely refresh it whenever it publishes a new Clarity Act post -- editing these fields carries far less risk than an unattended job hand-editing the page's HTML directly.
status_label_en: Post-Election Long Shot · Democrats Win Congress, Jan 3, 2027 Deadline (as of Nov 4, 2026)
status_label_ko: 선거 후 가능성 희박 · 민주당 의회 장악, 2027.1.3 시한 (2026.11.4 기준)
description_en: Failed Senate cloture 49-50 on Sept 15, 2026. After the Nov 3 midterms, outlets report Democrats won the House and the Senate; TD Cowen had warned a Democratic Congress would sink the bill for about two years. The only remaining path is a lame-duck vote before the 119th Congress ends on Jan 3, 2027, otherwise the bill dies and must be reintroduced.
description_ko: 2026.9.15 상원 클로처 49-50 부결. 11/3 중간선거 후 민주당이 하원과 상원을 차지한 것으로 보도됐고, TD Cowen은 민주당 의회가 법안을 약 2년간 좌초시킬 것이라 경고했다. 남은 길은 제119대 의회가 끝나는 2027.1.3 전 레임덕 표결뿐이며, 실패하면 폐기돼 재발의해야 한다.
